We propose a novel LLM-based approach for simulating and evaluating professional narrative therapy. Specifically, we introduce the Interactive Narrative Therapist (INT) for simulation and the Innovative Moment Assessment (IMA) for tracking and evaluating therapeutic progression, both grounded in core psychotherapy principles.
